# Lab 20.7: Fail a Cloud Build on Critical CVEs

## What We Are Going to Do
Build an image in Cloud Build, scan it before pushing, and stop the build if any critical vulnerability is found.

## Steps

1. **Give the build service account scanning rights.** New projects run builds as the Compute Engine default service account unless you choose another.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">export PROJECT_NUMBER=$(gcloud projects describe $PROJECT_ID --format="value(projectNumber)")
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=serviceAccount:$PROJECT_NUMBER-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/ondemandscanning.admin</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create a small app with an old base image.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">mkdir scan-build &amp;&amp; cd scan-build
echo "FROM nginx:1.18" &gt; Dockerfile</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Create `cloudbuild.yaml`.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">steps:
- id: build
  name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/docker
  args: ["build", "-t", "us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/$PROJECT_ID/lab-repo/app:$BUILD_ID", "."]

- id: scan
  name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk
  entrypoint: bash
  args:
  - -c
  - |
    gcloud artifacts docker images scan \
      us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/$PROJECT_ID/lab-repo/app:$BUILD_ID \
      --format="value(response.scan)" &gt; /workspace/scan_id.txt

- id: severity-check
  name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk
  entrypoint: bash
  args:
  - -c
  - |
    if gcloud artifacts docker images list-vulnerabilities $(cat /workspace/scan_id.txt) \
      --format="value(vulnerability.effectiveSeverity)" | grep -Fxq CRITICAL; then
      echo "CRITICAL vulnerabilities found. Failing the build." &amp;&amp; exit 1
    fi

- id: push
  name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/docker
  args: ["push", "us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/$PROJECT_ID/lab-repo/app:$BUILD_ID"]</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Run the build.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud builds submit --config=cloudbuild.yaml --region=us-central1 .</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The build fails at `severity-check`. The image is never pushed.

5. **Fix and rebuild.** Change the Dockerfile to a current base image, for example `FROM nginx:stable-alpine`, and run the build again. It passes if no critical CVEs remain.

6. **See the history.** In **Cloud Build → History**, open both builds and compare the steps.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Old base image | Build fails before push |
| Updated base image | Build passes and pushes |
| Gate | Runs on every build automatically |
| Tuning | Change `CRITICAL` to also block `HIGH` |
